name: m13-costume-cloud-skirt-render
command: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'; const peer = process.cwd() + '-ro-sdfm'; if (!process.env.SDFM_DIR && existsSync(peer + '/bin/sdfm.mjs')) process.env.SDFM_DIR = peer; const { main } = await import('./tools/renderViews.ts'); process.exit(await main(['proofs/m13/views/cloud-skirt.views.input.json']));"

name: m13-costume-cloud-skirt-judge
command: python3 $NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT out/m13/cloud-skirt/cloud-skirt-front.png --description "A cartoon penguin wearing a fluffy white cloud skirt: soft blended rounded puffs form a continuous skirt around its lower body, above its visible orange feet. The cloud hem is wider than its hips, with smaller puffs rising toward the waist." --min-score 6
